```{r}
counts <- ReadMtx(
   mtx = t("~/hpchome/counts.mtx"),
   features = "~/hpchome/genes.tsv",
   cells = "~/hpchome/barcodes.tsv", feature.column = 1, cell.column = 1, mtx.transpose = T)

meta <- read.csv("~/hpchome/cell_metadata.csv")
rownames(meta) <- meta$index
#gene.meta <- read.csv("~/hpchome/gene_metadata.csv")

sca <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, meta.data = meta, min.cells = 3, min.features = 300, project = "sca")

table(sca$donor_id)


sca$orig.ident <- sca$donor_id

sca@meta.data <- sca@meta.data[,1:3]
Idents(sca) <- sca$orig.ident

split.sca <- SplitObject(sca, split.by = "orig.ident")

list <- unique(sca$orig.ident)
sca.list2 <- list()
for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  mat <- GetAssayData(object = split.sca[[tmp]], layer = "counts", assay = "RNA")
  mat <- update_gene_names_sparse(mat)
  
  so <- CreateSeuratObject(mat, min.cells = 3, min.features = 300, project = tmp)
  so$barcode <- colnames(so)
  sca.list2[[tmp]] <- so 
}

saveRDS(sca.list2, file = "~/hpchome/sca.list.rds")
```
